summary: SQLite compatibility shim: ensure_sqlite_nat_adapter registers a process-global sqlite3 adapter that binds pandas NaT as NULL, because Ibis's SQLite memtable path round-trips through pandas and sqlite3 cannot bind NaTType (DEBT-13). Called before create_table, insert and upsert source staging.
lifecycle_notes: Idempotent; silently skipped when pandas is not importable
documentation_hooks: Null temporal values on SQLite writes
risks: Registers a process-global sqlite3 adapter, affecting other sqlite3 users in the same process
